codeReview.summary: Fail. Commit `70c2778` fixes the original prefix-match bug for the cached `/vnc` grid, but it applies that exact-match behavior through a shared `useVncSessions()` hook that is also used by the active `/vnc/session/:workflowId/:profileName` page. As a result, the session page stops auto-loading and live-refreshing its session data, so the rerun does not fully resolve the prior blocking issue without introducing a new blocking regression.

issues.description: Changing `useRouteActive('/vnc')` to exact equality does stop the hidden cached `/vnc` page from polling on `/vnc/session/:workflowId/:profileName`, matching `ProtectedLayoutShell`'s exact keep-alive visibility check (`frontend/src/components/layout/ProtectedLayoutShell.tsx:61-69`). But `useVncSessions()` still hardcodes `const isVisible = useRouteActive('/vnc')` (`frontend/src/features/vnc/hooks/useVncSessions.ts:15`) and uses that flag to gate both the websocket and the initial/interval `refresh()` work (`frontend/src/features/vnc/hooks/useVncSessions.ts:36-61`). That hook is also used by `VncSessionPageContainer` (`frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncSessionPageContainer.tsx:30`), so on the visible `/vnc/session/:workflowId/:profileName` route the hook now never auto-loads sessions and never subscribes for live updates. The container then falls through to the `This live session is no longer active.` state when `session` stays null (`frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncSessionPageContainer.tsx:70-77`), especially on direct loads or hard refreshes of a session URL.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `refactor-worker`'s integration-seam check is too direct-import-focused for shared hook behavior changes. The worker verified only the direct `useRouteActive` consumer and concluded no other callers were affected, but the regression actually came from downstream consumers of that consumer (`useVncSessions()` powering both `/vnc` and `/vnc/session/...`). The skill should explicitly require reviewing downstream usage when changing semantics of a shared hook/service, not just its immediate importers.

Current code shows `frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncSessionPageContainer.tsx:30` also depends on `useVncSessions()`, so the direct-consumer check missed the actual affected screen.

summary: Reviewed the prior failed review, the fix feature metadata/transcript/handoff, and commit diffs `2d3ddf4` and `70c2778`. The exact-match change fixes the cached `/vnc` grid visibility bug, but because `useVncSessions()` is shared with the visible VNC session route it now disables session-page auto-load/live updates and can falsely show 'Session unavailable' on direct session loads. Status: fail.
